summary.text: Cassandra Mayes is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas House of Representatives District 71 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Stephen Bright.
An education administrator, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a retired 30-year educator running for the second time.

paragraphs.text: Cassandra Mayes' career experience includes working as an education administrator.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a recently retired 30-year educator who supports her husband in pastoral ministry and is the primary caregiver to her mother, who has dementia.
Mayes was the Democratic nominee for District 71 in 2024, when incumbent Brandon Achor defeated her in the general election, 55.7 percent to 44.3 percent.
In her survey she said she is running a second time under a new name, having previously been Cassandra Green.
She said that public tax dollars should not go to students in private and homeschool settings at the expense of public education, and that affordable, accessible health care should be a top priority.
